payload.body_they: {{Name}} may know they have changed long before the people around them do, especially if they keep giving everyone the version of themselves people already understand. They can keep taking the familiar role, soften a decision they have already made, or describe themselves through a title that stopped feeling accurate. Then it becomes frustrating when nobody notices they have moved on. People who know them well need access to who they are now, not only the version that once made everything easier.
